title: signing.rs write_signing_key NoOverwrite check is not race-free (TOCTOU)
description: signing.rs write_signing_key with Overwrite::NoOverwrite calls path.exists() and then opens the file for writing with an atomic rename. The exists() check and the subsequent rename are not atomic — two concurrent callers can both see exists()=false and both proceed to write. The rename will overwrite the first writer's file silently, rotating the operator key. Use O_EXCL (OpenOptions::create_new(true)) to atomically fail if the file already exists, rather than a two-step check-then-act.
